sentences.en: Flesh gives birth to flesh, Spirit gives birth to Spirit.
sentences.zh: 肉体生出肉体，圣灵生出圣灵。

sentences.en: All the accepted notions and prejudices about flesh being pink.
sentences.zh: 所有关于肉是粉色的概念和偏见都被接受了。

sentences.en: He is bone of my bone, flesh of my flesh.
sentences.zh: 他是我的骨中之骨，肉中之肉。

senses.zh: 用肉喂，赋予血肉，使长肉
